description.en-US: Cocos Creator MCP capability router for the 84 Lite operations and Lumen asset editing.
description.zh-CN: 提供 84 个 Lite 操作与 Lumen 资产源文件编辑的 Cocos Creator MCP capability 路由器。

changes: Remove Pro-only preview capture and SnowB execution from Lite; Lite now activates without a Pro service.
creator2x: lumen.assetSet creates missing body assets (json/text/ts/anim/mtl/effect/…); Wave E compSet props for RichText/ProgressBar/Widget.
creator2x scene.open: use peanut-pod-24 scene-script + Editor.Scene.callSceneScript (remove broken scene:// and scene:open-by-uuid probes that spam Console).
creator2x scene.open: fallback via scene://utils/scene and Editor.Ipc scene:open-by-uuid when _Scene is unavailable in plugin host.
creator2x: CompatibleUuid for silent asset.copy/createFolder (no crypto.randomUUID); refuse asset.import of in-project sources to avoid AssetDB already-in-database.
fix: lumen.bindController plan() no longer routes through 3.x lumen gateway validate (was falsely refusing on creator2x).
asset.writeText: silent UTF-8 write under assets/ with coalesced lumen.refresh (batch files[]; prefer over IDE writeFile while Creator is open.
creator2x: stop blind 3.x sendToMain probes; expand assetSet to 2.4 docs kinds; UI builtins Wave E; asset.import + ensureSpriteFramesBatch via AssetDB.
creator2x Wave C: assetSet(texture/json/text/js), bindSpriteBatch, bindController, preview.refresh via AssetDB, scene.open via _Scene.loadSceneByUuid.
creator2x: asset.copy/move/rename/reimport allow; createFolder writes 2.4 folder meta on disk (no 0-byte AssetDB create).
creator2x asset.delete via AssetDB; lumen.refresh skips missing paths (parent fallback) to avoid ENOENT on stale index.
creator2x lumen-24 bindRef: map 3.x Button.target to 2.4 _N$target (Inspector-visible node ref).
creator2x Wave C1: lumen-24 .fire Scene scaffold/tree/inspect/node* (official new-scene shape); shared prefabRelativePath.
creator2x Wave B3: lumen.bindRef / structure / compileRecipe via lumen-24; policy allowlist expanded.
asset.ensureSpriteFramesBatch: save-asset-meta batch ensure PNG @f9941 SpriteFrame (no disk .meta surgery).
lumen.inspect: Prefab/Scene omit nodePath defaults to root node (stops policy warn noise).
AssetDB sync: refresh-only for existing disk assets (no save-asset race); parent discover + global refresh queue; offline writes defer refresh to commit.
High-concurrency: per-asset write lock, import-dir lock, Hub write slots (16), parallel validateRefs.
Map lumen client rejects to editor_mcp_lumen_operation_unsupported so project.log stays warn even before host extension hot-reload.
compile-recipe: treat template=empty as components; bindSprite rejects nil uuid before catalog; broader lumen client warn classification in host.

project.log hygiene: lumen client rejects as warn; postflight trusts Creator severity; compile-recipe wires templates; bindClick rejects cc.*; path root alias; asset-import rename strips source meta uuid.
Capability lane: lumen-offline | editor-ui | preview on catalog/plan; scene.open/reload are presentation-only; commit nextHint never requires scene open/reload for writing.
scene.open: fall back to asset-db open-asset(UUID) when open-scene throws; surface message errors; still never pass db://.
Hard-block Creator save-scene/save-as/save at message layer (confirm dialog hangs automation); disk .scene.meta UUID fallback for open; probe picks existing AppQaSmoke/McpVerify scene.
scene.createNode/unlink: resolve parent UUID, expand create-node candidates, fall back to host scene script createChildNode/unlinkPrefabInstance; hierarchy get retries before query-node-tree.
Hard-block open-scene args that are not UUID (prevents import://db/db://…); open incomplete if hierarchy empty; probe opens TableViewTest.scene.
scene.getHierarchy falls back to query-node-tree when host scene script returns empty; scene.open settle uses the same fallback.
scene.open: resolve db path → UUID before open-scene (Creator rejects db:// and produces import://db/db://…).
preview.queryErrors: sinceOffset + logOffset/newErrorCount/verified for delta-only Agent accept; probe uses baseline→sinceOffset.
Agent accept pipeline: commit returns acceptancePipeline; validation fail → validateRefs next; tool descriptions mark steps 1–3; probe-agent-accept-pipeline.mjs.
scene.save refuses Creator save-scene/save-as (confirm UI hangs Agents); redirect to lumen offline write → commit → reload/refresh.
Core PinK align: startScenePath resolve; asset/scene open attach validateRefs; search type+pathContains; selection items.
preview.query: merge startScene from project.json general even when preview.json only has port.
PinK 33: findReferencingNodes missingOnly + node name/path filters.
preview.query nested general.startScene; queryErrors.contains; asset.open thin layer.
preview.query: prefer live Creator messages with live_tried fallback annotation.
validateRefs: ignore default_prefab / engine builtin uuids (ignoredEngineDefaultUuid).
Agent pipeline + scene thin-layer probe docs; install always development reload + Hub reloadSettings.
preview.capture: screenshot via system Node child_process + local playwright (Electron-safe).
preview.capture: screenshot via system Node child_process + local playwright (Electron-safe).
preview.capture: createRequire from playwright package.json for Creator Electron resolve.
preview.query: probe ports and prefer HTML title matching project name (multi-Creator safe).
preview.capture: resolve playwright from nearby node_modules when Creator cwd lacks it.
preview.capture: only treat Creator message as success when output file is non-empty; otherwise fall through to playwright.
Wave A/B/C: preview.query/refresh/queryErrors/capture, asset diagnostics, sessionBound approval.
scene.resolvePrefabRootUuid 未解析时软返回 unresolved，避免刷 project.log。
lumen 执行前剥离 confirmDestructive/approvalToken/resources，避免字段校验误伤。
导入结果以 Creator 返回 url 记入账本，避免 rename 目标漂移。
AssetDB refresh 同步刷父目录；bindSprite 前 assertManaged。
lumen PrefabDocument 增加 removeNodeByIndex / setScriptProperties。
入口 call 说明：资产须 importPlan→import→managedStatus，禁止旁路拷贝。
入口 call/query 不再把 Hub 的 approvalToken/resources 灌入 lumen/operation 字段校验。
配合真机深覆盖验收脚本 verify-host-deep-coverage。
新增 asset.managedStatus：MCP 导入账本检疫（.peanut-ai/import-ledger.json）。
新增 asset.queryDependencies：磁盘序列化依赖图（不依赖 Creator query-dependencies）。
asset.importPlan / asset.import 接线 planId 与账本记录。
lumen.assetSet 校验补丁内非空 Creator uuid（含 @子资源）必须存在于 asset-catalog，拒绝占位假 uuid。
宿主烟测补 C11：SpriteAtlas / TS / Mesh inspect + JavaScript isPlugin 族可写。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 instantiation-skeleton .skeleton、instantiation-animation .animation 与 instantiation-material .material 旁路 .meta。
只读 uuid；不改引擎 dump 源；与 .anim 剪辑、.mtl 材质文档分开。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 TypeScript .ts、JavaScript .js 与 instantiation-mesh .mesh 旁路 .meta。
TS / mesh dump 只读 uuid；JS 写 isPlugin 加载开关；不改脚本或引擎 dump 源。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持独立 Render Flow .flow 与 Render Stage .stg。
改 name / priority / tag；Flow 改 stageUuids；不做 dump 树 UI。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 Buffer .bin 旁路 .meta。
3.8 无可写字段；不改源、不做二进制预览。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持粒子 / Sprite Atlas .plist 与 JSON / 文本旁路 .meta。
.plist 按 importer 区分 particle 与 sprite-atlas；3.8 无可写字段；不改源、不做粒子或图集预览、不克隆代码预览。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 CubeMap / TiledMap / 文件夹 Bundle 旁路 .meta。
CubeMap 改六面 uuid 与过滤；TiledMap 3.8 无可写字段；文件夹改 isBundle / bundleName / priority；不改源、不做预览。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 Spine / DragonBones 旁路 .meta。
Spine 改 atlasUuid；DragonBones 骨骼与图集 3.8 无可写字段；不改源、不做动画预览。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持音频 / 视频 / TTF / BitmapFont 旁路 .meta。
音频改 downloadMode；视频与 TTF 3.8 无可写字段；BitmapFont 改 textureUuid / fontSize；不改源文件、不做播放器或字形预览。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 Animation Graph / Variant / Mask 与 RenderTexture / Pipeline。
动画图改图层与变量，不做状态机节点图；RenderTexture 改尺寸与过滤；Pipeline 改 name/tag/流名，不做 dump 树 UI。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 Auto Atlas .pac 与 LabelAtlas .labelatlas。
Auto Atlas 改 .meta 打包与贴图过滤；LabelAtlas 改 spriteFrameUuid / 格子；不做预览或压缩贴图 UI。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 FBX / glTF .meta：Model / FBX / Material 页与内嵌图 remap。
asset-catalog 增加 model / mesh 分桶；不 scaffold、不改模型源与 library。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持 Effect .effect 与 chunk：YAML properties、CCProgram 源、整文件 source。
asset-catalog 增加 effect 分桶（importer effect / chunk）。
lumen.inspect / lumen.assetSet 支持图片 .meta 的 Texture 与 SpriteFrame 设置。
覆盖过滤、寻址、各向异性、九宫格、pivot、packable 与透明伪影修复；不改图片源和缓存目录。
lumen.inspect 地形可传 region（顶点盒或本地圆）读高度窗。
lumen.assetSet 地形窗口写：props.region + heights，或 props.samples。
Terrain .terrain 写 Creator VERSION8 高度场（tileSize/blockCount/ramp/heights/layerInfos）。
cc.Terrain.asset 可绑地形 uuid。
lumen.assetSet / inspect 覆盖 AnimationClip .anim、PhysicsMaterial .pmtl、Terrain .terrain。
asset-catalog 增加 material / animationClip / physicsMaterial / terrain 分桶。
lumen.assetSet 写入 Material .mtl Inspector 字段；inspect 可省略 nodePath。
prefabRelativePath 增加 assetRelativePath 别名，覆盖 .prefab / .scene / .mtl。
lumen 同一套 prefabRelativePath 读写 .scene；节点/组件 CRUD 与 Prefab 对齐。
实例发现覆盖 __id__ 引用与未知嵌套对象；CurveRange TwoCurves / GradientRange TwoGradients。
lumen.cocosInfo 支持 gapOffset/gapLimit；报告 inEngineNotInWhitelist 分页缺口（禁止自动写入白名单）。
粒子 overtime 模块支持嵌套 curveRange/gradientRange（colorOverLifetime / size / velocity 等）。
脚本 @property 半自动发现：lumen-schema / comp-add / comp-set / inspect 按 catalog 解析 .ts 并注册字段。
lumen 挂载约定：Renderer 互斥校验、UI_2D/DEFAULT Layer 自动写入；schema 返回 conventions / layerRole。
修复 lumen-structure / comp-set / node-set 的 object 输入 schema（additionalProperties），使 recipe/props 可通过 MCP 校验。
写操作返回 recommendedNext；支持 autoCommit；新增 lumen.cocosInfo。
新增 lumen.commit：写盘后 AssetDB refresh + asset-catalog 重建受管收口。
新增 lumen Prefab CRUD MCP：schema/templates/tree/inspect 与 scaffold/structure/node/comp/bind/refresh。
资产目录迁入 core/@peanut/pod-engine/assets，并经 assetCatalog grant 暴露。
新增资产目录 MCP 快查：asset.catalog.summary / lookup / refresh。
提供 Editor MCP action router，并通过受管 SnowB 服务支持 BMFont 导出。
